name: Photo mode: viewfinder, flash, HUD counter and album
body: Viewfinder corners and crosshair, a flash on the shutter, a photo counter in the status line, and an album tally (taken / total, with sight titles) on the level complete screen.

comments.text: Done: built and checked in a cloud session (lavapipe screenshots, mist run test 216/216). Frame time not measured on a real GPU.
